listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Ari Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description:
A floral, fruity, ultra-feminine eau de parfum.

Ariana Grande’s Ari Eau de Parfum Spray features a super feminine, floral and fruity fragrance, with top notes of raspberry, pear and grapefruit on woody base notes of marshmallow and musk. Perfect for everyday, this eau de parfum, housed in a cute pink bottle with white pom-pom, also features scents of vanilla orchid, rose and lily of the valley. Buy now, thank us later.

- Fragrance Family: fruity, floral, gourmand 
- Top Notes: raspberry, pear, grapefruit
- Heart Notes: vanilla orchid, rose, lily of the valley
- Base Notes: marshmallow, musk, woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Cloud Pink Eau De Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description:
A woody fragrance.

Spritz on something warm and woody with the Ariana Grande CLOUD PINK Eau De Parfum Spray. It's a sensual blend of ambery woods, magenta moss, and a touch of sweetened praline. The journey begins with a velvety blend of rich berries and sparkling fruit while the delicate floralcy of vanilla orchid and blush ambrette wrap you in an embrace of feathery, cotton-like clouds. The lasting impression, a warm blend of addictive, skin-sensual musk and amber woods indulge the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Your Turn Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description:
A warm, woody, fresh scent.

The Billie Eilish Your Turn Eau de Parfum was created with versatility in mind. First you'll smell notes of tangy bergamot, deep cardomom, and zesty fresh giner. Next, you'll recognise light, velvety accords of peach skin and jasmine. And it finishes off with a delicious, hearty blend of sandalwood, musks, and sylvamber. All packaged up in a stylish stacked dice duo.

__Top notes:__ Bergamot, cardamom, fresh ginger

__Heart notes:__ Peach skin, jasmine

__Base notes:__ Sandalwood, musks, sylvamber

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Your Turn II Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description:
A bold woody-fruity fragrance that blends sweet, fresh, and warm notes for a modern, long-lasting scent.

A deeper, more expressive verison of the original, Billie Eilish Your Turn II Eau De Parfum is designed to contrast light and dark in one wearable fragrance. It opens with juicy mirabelle plum, spicy pimento berry, and crisp cassis leaves. The scent then softens into fig nectar, black tea, and vanilla orchid, before settling into a warm base of vetiver, cedarwood, and resin for a smooth, lasting finish. It evolves beautifully on the skin, moving from bright and fruity to warm and grounding throughout the day.

- Vegan
- Cruelty-free
- Paraben-free
